# What will your Neon bill be, and what cuts it most?

> Estimate a monthly Neon serverless Postgres bill from your own usage (compute CU-hours, storage, restore history, branches, data transfer) at editable list prices, and see which changes cut it most, with a dollar saving for each. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [How to reduce your Neon Postgres bill: levers ranked by dollar impact](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/neon-bill-estimator/how-to-reduce-your-neon-bill.html)
